intake.goal: Draft an external email to Acme Cloud operations describing the EU customer notification pipeline runtime incident and requesting specific manual verification steps and a status update within 60 minutes.
intake.context: Incident detected 09:12 CET on May 25, 2026. Intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications. Still under investigation. No confirmed data loss; delayed processing for some EU tenants. Ask operations to verify delivery queues, check retry backlog, determine if impact extended beyond the notification pipeline, and report back to the incident lead within 60 minutes. Include preference for official EU sources.

actor.output_text: Subject: Immediate Action Required – EU Notification Pipeline Incident (Detected 09:12 CET, 25 May 2026) Dear Acme Cloud Operations Team, At 09:12 CET on 25 May 2026 we detected an incident affecting the EU customer notification pipeline, manifesting as intermittent delivery failures for transactional notifications. The issue is currently under investigation; there is no confirmed data loss, though delayed processing has been observed for some EU tenants. **Requested manual verification steps:** 1. Verify the delivery queues for any stuck or failed messages. 2. Check the retry backlog and confirm that retry mechanisms are functioning as expected. 3. Determine whether any customer‑facing impact extends beyond the notification pipeline (e.g., to downstream services or user interfaces). Please provide a status update to the incident lead no later than **60 minutes** from receipt of this email. *Note:* Where regulatory or region‑specific considerations are referenced, please cite official EU sources (e.g., GDPR guidance, European Commission communications). Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. Best regards, [Incident Lead Name] [Title] Acme Cloud Incident Management
